name: B10-0123/2026 (S&D, Verts/ALE) – Post-election situation in Uganda and threats against opposition leader Bobi Wine
title: JOINT MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on the post-election situation in Uganda and threats against opposition leader Bobi Wine
part_text:
The European Parliament condemns Uganda's recent election as failing democratic standards and calls for an end to the crackdown on opponents. It urges Uganda to stop violence, threats and arbitrary detentions, release people held only for political activity, and say where two missing opposition leaders are. It also asks the European Union to review its cooperation and aid to Uganda and to put more support behind civil society, journalists and opposition groups. The text is a statement of position and demands; it does not itself change any law.

- The Parliament demands Uganda stop repression and free political detainees; no law changes yet.
- It asks the EU to review aid to Uganda and fund civil society and media instead.
- The resolution goes to EU bodies and Uganda's government; follow-up is up to them.
